title: The Last Delivery
summary: Take Bram's letters to Ilse at the Last Fire up the north road. She'll explain the rest.
ask: Bram: Ilse keeps the last fire up the north road. Past it, it's only hunters. Take these letters to her, and she'll explain the rest.

steps.text: Leave the city through the High Gate
done: Hale: Got your licence? Good, go on through. It's not too dangerous out here near the city, but keep your eyes open.

steps.text: Take the letters to the Last Fire up the north road

done: Ilse: You're the one from the square. Sit down, the kettle's nearly on.
Ilse: Here. It's a coal from this fire. Put it down wherever you want to live, and that's your home. Nobody will come and bother you out there. Nobody can.

steps.text: Place your Ember where you want your home
